create_trie_from_sequences: create a Trie from a list of integer sequences for prefix-based token lookups
query_trie_prefix: query a Trie with a prefix sequence to get valid next token candidates
build_marisa_trie: build a MarisaTrie from integer sequences using marisa_trie for efficient prefix search
load_trie_from_dict: load a Trie instance from an existing trie dictionary using the load_from_dict static method
create_dummy_trie_mention: create a DummyTrieMention that always returns fixed values for mention token generation
